normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Sea Ya Soon,” your next unforgettable getaway in 30A's Seacrest Beach! Just steps from the 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool and a short tram ride to sugar-white sands, this home is where memories are made. With 4 cozy suites, the brand-new interiors blend coastal charm with modern elegance. Soak up the sun, explore nearby shops, ride bikes to Rosemary and savor sunsets with your favorite people. Ready to dive in? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Lagoon Pool Access – Just a 2-minute walk to a stunning 12,000 sq ft tropical pool. Perfect for lazy afternoons and family fun under the sun.Beach Access Nearby – Only a 7-minute walk or a relaxing seasonal tram ride takes you to the pristine Gulf shores. Feel the sand between your toes and enjoy breathtaking seaside views.Brand-New Build – Experience the luxury of modern design with high-end finishes. A fresh, clean, and airy retreat awaits you.Prime Location – Immerse yourself in the heart of Seacrest with dining, shops, and entertainment just steps away. Explore nearby beaches for ultimate coastal living.Sleeps 10 Comfortably – Spacious and inviting, with 4 en-suite bedrooms, a cozy bunk nook, and luxurious en-suites to ensure everyone feels at home.Gourmet Kitchen – Cook in style with stainless steel appliances, island seating for family gatherings, and a chic backsplash that adds a touch of elegance.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Beautiful property in a great spot. Perfect for families with kids, so close to everything!" – Erin M.⭐ "Perfect location! Easy walk to the beach, pool, and restaurants. Clean and so spacious!" – Ryan B.⭐ "Stunning home, very well-kept. The Lagoon Pool was a hit with our kids. Can't wait to return!" – Taylor D.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into the bright and inviting open-concept living space on the first floor, thoughtfully designed for both relaxation and entertaining. The living room boasts a plush sectional sofa, a sleek flat-screen TV, and expansive windows that flood the space with natural light. Step outside to your private patio, perfect for soaking up the fresh air or firing up the grill for a delicious outdoor meal.Seamless open-concept layout for effortless entertainingCozy sectional sofa and smart TV for ultimate comfortPrivate Outdoor Patio with Seating and Propane Grill*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Create gourmet meals or enjoy your favorite takeout in this beautifully designed kitchen. With sleek stainless steel appliances, a coastal-inspired mermaid tile backsplash, and a spacious center island with bar seating, it blends style and function. The dining area features a round table for six, plus three barstools at the island—perfect for family gatherings or weekend brunches.Modern stainless steel appliances for effortless cookingCoastal-inspired mermaid tile backsplash for a unique touchDining table for 6, plus 3 barstools at the island for added seating*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Every bedroom in this new construction home is equipped with comfortable mattresses, hotel-grade linens, and smart TVs.1st Floor:Half Bath: Conveniently located off the main living area2nd Floor:King Guest Bedroom: 1 King Bed, private en-suite bathroom with walk-in showerPrimary Suite: 1 King Bed, private en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower3rd Floor:Bunk Nook: Custom Twin-over-Twin bunk bed in the hallwayKing Guest Bedroom: 1 King Bed, private en-suite bathroom with walk-in showerQueen Guest Bedroom: 1 Queen Bed, private en-suite bathroom with tub/shower combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, this home offers unmatched access to boutique shops, gourmet dining, and family-friendly entertainment. Walk to nearby Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, or explore scenic trails and live music at Peddler’s Pavilion.12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool – Just a 2-minute walk away, this stunning pool area features loungers, cascading waterfalls, and a fun splash zone perfect for relaxing or making family memories.Seasonal Tram to the Beach – A 7-minute walk to hop on the tram and enjoy a breezy ride to the beach, making your beach day easy and stress-free.Peddler’s Pavilion – Just a 5-minute stroll to this lively spot with local shops, bike rentals, and live music, perfect for a casual outing.Rosemary Beach – Only 8 minutes on foot to this charming seaside town with cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a laid-back coastal vibe.Alys Beach – A 10-minute walk to a picturesque community known for its white-washed architecture, upscale atmosphere, and serene ambiance.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in quotes but can be purchased during booking.We DO NOT accept wire transfers.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 117892STRO #: STR-117892
